metadata.format: Template inventory with per-occurrence exact Dart bindings; not runtime locale catalogs
metadata.sourceMethod: Dart analyzer AST; local BASE-to-overlay comparison restricts shared strings to new/changed spans; one source-hashed internal SQL literal classified by documented code review
metadata.placeholderConvention: {p1}, {p2}, ... are positional within each template; source bindings retain nested expressions and locale-specific terms; do not evaluate code
metadata.extractionReplayNote: The raw extractor remains conservative. Reapply this reviewed exclusion only if the source SHA-256 and exact literal template hash match; otherwise review again.
